body:
PROBLEM (observed on PR #493, 2026-08-13): segment files under `.adlc/manifest.d/` chain-anchor to an entry in the ROOT `.adlc/manifest.jsonl` (the cutover entry). Two consumers read a segment WITHOUT resolving that anchor and report a broken chain that is not broken:

1. `adlc gate-manifest verify` run locally in a worktree reports 'chain broken at seq 1: unsigned entry' — a pre-existing, CI-tolerated false negative that operators must be told to ignore (it is documented as a gotcha, which is the failure).
2. An adversarial cross-model review of a PR whose diff includes manifest.d segment files sees only the diff, cannot resolve the anchor, and reports 'disconnected hash chain' — a standing objection that blocked PR #493's sanctioned approval path until the tier fix (#506) made it moot for ticket-only PRs. Trust-root PRs that legitimately still require cross-model review keep hitting it.

BUILD

1. Teach the verify path (packages/gate-manifest, the forest reader) to resolve a segment's root anchor from git when the root manifest is available at a base revision: given `--base <ref>` (or the repo's tracked root manifest), load the root chain, verify the segment's anchor against it, and only then judge the segment chain. Anchor unresolvable → the CURRENT behavior (fail closed) stays.
2. Teach the review-packet builder used for cross-model review of trust-root changes (packages/prosecute) to include the resolved anchor context (root entry hash + seq) alongside the segment diff, so an isolated reviewer can verify continuity instead of flagging it.
3. Update the operator gotcha docs: local verify with a resolvable root must PASS with no caveat.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA

- AC1: in a fixture repo with a root manifest plus one anchored segment, `adlc gate-manifest verify` (with the root present) exits 0 with no 'chain broken' report. Verify: new test in packages/gate-manifest/test/, named in the build.
- AC2: a segment whose anchor hash does NOT match any root entry still fails closed with a distinct message naming the anchor mismatch. Verify: same test file.
- AC3: the prosecute review packet for a diff touching manifest.d embeds the resolved anchor context. Verify: new/extended test in packages/prosecute/test/.
- AC4: suite green: npm test.

NOTES FOR THE BUILDER

- Re-verify the exact anchor mechanics against packages/gate-manifest/lib (forest reader) before building; the 'chain broken at seq 1' message text may have moved with #508's seq-contiguity enforcement.
- Enforcement-package change: this PR will tier trust-root and needs a distinct-provider cross-model approve.
- No rails declared here (2026-08-14 lesson: railed tickets merged ahead of their builds wedge the build PR); freeze tests in-session during the build.
title: Resolve the root-manifest anchor when verifying or reviewing segmented manifest.d changes
